name: Ultimate Light Rail
summary: Light rail stations, terminus operation and fenced tracks in a dedicated build menu.
description: Ultimate Light Rail 1.0.0 adds a dedicated Light Rail construction menu with the native tram depot, fenced light rail track and configurable passenger stations. Choose surface, underground or elevated; through or terminus; 40, 60, 80, 100 or 120 metre platforms; and approach fences. Terminus stations include crossover tracks and support reversing tram vehicles. Elevated stations include concrete structures, roofs and a central street-level entrance. Uses existing tram vehicles and connects to native tram infrastructure. The public API v1 and 20 metre component kit let asset makers add station designs to the same menu. Vehicles must fit the selected platform length. Other mods replacing the same construction UI may conflict. Updates and extensions within the documented public API v1 contract remain backward compatible. Breaking changes will use a new API version alongside v1; existing conforming v1 add-ons will remain supported. Included stations are available from 1925, matching the modern native tram track.
